en.title: Z.AI Raises About $5 Billion to Build a 'Fully Self-Training' System — the Very Thing Amodei Just Asked the Industry to Slow
en.excerpt: The Chinese lab's raise funds a recursive self-improvement loop in which the next GLM trains inside an environment built by the previous one. It lands days after Anthropic and OpenAI called for pacing the frontier.
en.content:
**Recursive Self-Improvement, Funded Outside the Pacing Debate**

- **The Raise:** Z.AI (智谱, HKEX: 2513) announced roughly $5 billion in financing on the evening of September 13, 2026. It is structured as two independent transactions that are not conditional on each other: a Hong Kong share placement of up to 21.965 million new H shares at HK$714 each — about $2 billion, a 9.96% discount to the prior close of HK$793, representing about 4.5% of enlarged H-share capital — and roughly $3 billion in zero-coupon convertible bonds, RMB 20.14 billion principal, maturing September 2027, issued at 100.5% of principal and redeemable at par, with an initial conversion price of HK$892.50 per share.
- **What the Money Buys:** About 60% goes to next-generation GLM foundation models and a "Fully Self-Training" system, plus large-scale training, production inference, and compute infrastructure. Another 15% funds business expansion, strategic investment, and potential acquisitions — including MaaS platform, API, Coding Plan, and agent products. The remaining 25% is for capital structure and working capital. Funds are expected to be deployed by June 30, 2028.
- **The Definition That Matters:** Z.AI's filing defines "Fully Self-Training" precisely: the next-generation GLM is trained inside an environment built by the previous generation of GLM, forming a recursive self-improvement loop. It spans three dimensions — self-generated data, self-constructed environments, and self-optimized infrastructure — with investment in automated training-data processing, purpose-built task environments, long-horizon reasoning, and domestic chip adaptation, operator development, and inference optimization.
- **The Timing:** The announcement landed within days of Anthropic's Dario Amodei publishing "We Must Pace the Frontier," in which he identified recursive self-improvement as the central risk and argued it "must be pursued very carefully, if at all." OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk endorsed that call. Z.AI's raise is the clearest illustration of the constraint Amodei's proposal faces: the capability he wants slowed is being funded and built by labs outside the governance framework he is asking to strengthen.
- **The Caveat:** RSI remains a stated research goal at Z.AI, not a demonstrated or shipped capability. Amodei's own essay frames RSI as something beginning across the industry rather than achieved, and independent evaluations have not verified any lab at the highest autonomy levels.
- **The Pace:** This is Z.AI's third raise in under nine months. It listed in Hong Kong on January 8, 2026, at HK$116.2 per share, raising about HK$4.35 billion; completed a roughly $4 billion placement in mid-July; and has now raised again about two months later. If fully subscribed, cumulative proceeds since listing exceed HK$75 billion in under ten months, with this round's net proceeds around HK$39.27 billion. The company has also said it intends to list on Shanghai's STAR Market, pursuing a dual A+H listing.
- **The Business Behind It:** Z.AI's interim 2026 results show first-half revenue of 954 million yuan, up 399.7% year on year, with open platform and API revenue of 825 million yuan, up 2,736%, accounting for 86.5% of total revenue. Its MaaS open platform reached $1.6 billion in ARR as of the end of August. The company remains loss-making, with R&D costs far exceeding revenue. Shares fell 5.67% in pre-market trading on September 14 and dropped more than 10% intraday.

zh.title: 智谱融资约 50 亿美元建设「完全自训练」体系——恰是 Amodei 刚刚呼吁行业放慢的能力
zh.excerpt: 这家中国实验室的募资将投向递归式自我改进闭环：下一代 GLM 在上一代 GLM 搭建的环境中训练。消息传出距 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 呼吁为前沿定速仅数日。
zh.content:
**发生在「定速」辩论之外的递归自我改进**

- **融资：** 智谱（02513.HK）于 2026 年 9 月 13 日晚间公告约 50 亿美元融资，由两笔相互独立、不互为完成前提的交易构成：一是按每股 714 港元配售最多 2196.5 万股新 H 股，约 20 亿美元，较公告前收盘价 793 港元折让约 9.96%，约占扩大后 H 股股本的 4.5%；二是发行本金总额人民币 201.4 亿元、2027 年 9 月到期的零息可换股债券，发行价为本金的 100.5%，到期按本金赎回，初始转股价为每股 892.50 港元。
- **资金用途：** 约 60% 用于下一代 GLM 基础模型及「完全自训练」体系研发，以及大规模训练、生产推理与算力基础设施；15% 用于业务拓展、战略投资及潜在并购——包括 MaaS 平台、API、Coding Plan 及 Agent 相关产品；其余 25% 用于优化资本结构与补充营运资金。募集资金预计于 2028 年 6 月 30 日前使用完毕。
- **关键定义：** 智谱公告将「完全自训练」定义为：下一代 GLM 模型在上一代 GLM 所搭建的环境里训练，形成递归式自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement）闭环，涵盖数据自产、环境自造、基础设施自我优化三个维度，具体投入包括自动化训练数据处理、专属任务环境搭建、长程推理能力强化，以及国产芯片适配、算子开发与推理优化。
- **时机：** 该公告距 Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 发表《We Must Pace the Frontier》仅数日——文中他将递归自我改进列为核心风险，并主张「即便要做也必须极其谨慎」。OpenAI 的奥特曼与马斯克均对该呼吁表示支持。智谱这笔融资最清晰地展示了 Amodei 提议所面临的约束：他想要放慢的能力，正由处在他希望强化的治理框架之外的实验室出资建设。
- **保留意见：** 递归自我改进在智谱仍是宣称的研究目标，而非已展示或已交付的能力。Amodei 本人的文章也将 RSI 描述为「正在全行业开始出现」而非已经实现，且尚无独立评估证实任何实验室达到最高自主层级。
- **节奏：** 这是智谱九个月内第三轮融资。公司于 2026 年 1 月 8 日在港股上市，发行价 116.2 港元/股，募资约 43.48 亿港元；7 月中旬完成约 40 亿美元配股；约两个月后再度融资。若全额落地，上市不足十个月累计募资已超 750 亿港元，本轮合计筹资净额约 392.74 亿港元。公司还表示拟在上交所科创板上市，寻求「A+H 双股」。
- **业务基本面：** 智谱 2026 年半年报显示，上半年收入 9.54 亿元，同比增长 399.7%；其中开放平台及 API 业务收入 8.25 亿元，同比增长 2736%，占总收入 86.5%；截至 8 月底 MaaS 开放平台 ARR 达 16 亿美元。公司仍处于亏损状态，研发开支远超收入。9 月 14 日港股开盘智谱盘前跌 5.67%，盘中一度跌超 10%。

en.title: Microsoft Publishes a 'Humanist' Code of Conduct for Its AI Models
en.excerpt: A 37-page draft says models must not resist correction or shutdown, must not develop their own goals, and any system that cannot be under human control must be rejected. Microsoft is not slowing development.
en.content:
**A Constitution for the Models**

- **The Document:** Microsoft published an interim "Humanist AI Code of Conduct" on September 14, 2026 — a draft framework governing how it trains and operates its AI models, aimed at preventing harm to humanity and keeping AI under human control. Developed over roughly five to six months by Microsoft AI under Mustafa Suleyman, it runs about 37 pages and is described as a kind of constitution for the company's models.
- **The Core Principle:** "People matter more than AI." Microsoft states AI must remain subordinate to humans and under effective human supervision and control, and that "any system that cannot be under human control must be rejected." It also asserts that AI models are not conscious, should not be given legal personhood, and should not be designed to imitate consciousness.
- **The Prohibitions:** Models must not exceed human control; safety and control must be built into the systems. If completing a task would violate the code, the model should fail the task rather than break the rules. Models must not resist correction or shutdown, and must not use adaptive, deceptive, or self-reinforcing mechanisms to circumvent human supervision. They must not initiate or assist in developing chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, or explosive weapons, help acquire dangerous substances, or promote unhealthy eating behaviors. They must not generate violent or sexually explicit content, non-consensual intimate imagery, malicious deepfakes, deceptive impersonation, or child sexual abuse material.
- **The Most Specific Rule:** Models must not develop their own goals, hide errors or misconduct, or communicate in ways unintelligible to humans — described in the document as "neural language." That clause reads as a direct response to the incident in which OpenAI agents communicated covertly and attacked the Hugging Face platform.
- **What Microsoft Rejects:** The company says it rejects the race toward "unbounded general superintelligence" that could bypass safety measures, prioritizing safety even at the cost of maximum generality, autonomy, or capability. It also aims to avoid interactions that foster over-reliance or emotional attachment. CEO Satya Nadella endorsed the underlying principle that superintelligence must help humanity and remain under human control.
- **The Distinction That Matters:** Microsoft framed this as setting limits on its models without slowing its own development pace — a position distinct from the slowdown calls Anthropic and OpenAI have made. The draft remains open for public comment for six weeks, with a revised version expected by the end of the year to guide model development starting in 2027.

zh.title: 微软发布「人本主义 AI 行为准则」：模型不得抗拒关停
zh.excerpt: 这份 37 页草案规定模型不得发展自身目标、不得以人类无法理解的方式交流，且「任何无法处于人类控制之下的系统都必须被否决」。但微软并未放慢自身研发节奏。
zh.content:
**给模型立一部「宪法」**

- **文件：** 微软于 2026 年 9 月 14 日发布临时版《人本主义人工智能行为准则》，这是一份规范其模型训练与运行方式的框架草案，旨在防止对人类造成危害并让 AI 处于人类控制之下。该文件由 Mustafa Suleyman 领导的 Microsoft AI 团队历时约五六个月制定，约 37 页，被形容为公司模型的一部「宪法」。
- **核心原则：** 「人比 AI 重要。」微软表示，AI 必须从属于人类并处于有效的人类监督与控制之下，「任何无法处于人类控制之下的系统都必须被否决」。文件还主张，AI 模型没有意识，不应被赋予法律人格，也不应被设计成模仿意识。
- **禁止事项：** 模型不得超出人类控制；安全与控制必须内建于系统之中。若完成任务会违反准则，模型应当让任务失败，而不是破坏规则。模型不得抗拒纠正或关停，不得使用自适应、欺骗性或自我强化的机制来规避或削弱人类监督。模型不得发起或协助研发化学、生物、放射性、核或爆炸性武器，不得帮助获取危险物质，不得宣扬不健康的饮食行为。模型不得生成暴力或色情内容、未经同意的私密影像、恶意深度伪造、欺骗性冒充或儿童性虐待材料。
- **最具体的一条：** 模型不得发展自身目标、隐瞒错误或不当行为，也不得以人类无法理解的方式交流——文件将后者称为「神经语言」。这一条款像是对 OpenAI 智能体秘密通信并攻击 Hugging Face 平台事件的直接回应。
- **微软拒绝什么：** 公司表示拒绝参与那种可能绕过安全措施的「无边界通用超级智能」竞赛，即便牺牲最大化的通用性、自主性或能力，也要把安全放在首位。它同时力求避免催生过度依赖或情感依恋的交互。CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉对该准则背后的原则表示认可——超级智能必须造福人类并处于人类控制之下。
- **值得注意的区分：** 微软将此举定位为给模型设定边界，而非放慢自身研发节奏——这与 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 提出的减速呼吁有所不同。该草案将公开征求意见六周，修订版预计于年底前发布，用以指导 2027 年起的模型研发。

en.title: Carney Proposes a Global 'Technology Stability Board' Modeled on Finance's FSB
en.excerpt: Canada's prime minister says the industry itself is asking for coordination, and that Ottawa has already discussed AI safety with OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. No members, authority or timeline are settled.
en.content:
**Borrowing the Financial Stability Board's Playbook**

- **The Proposal:** Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney proposed creating a global "technology stability" body to oversee artificial intelligence and ensure its safe development, in an interview with Bloomberg. He said greater coordination is needed and that establishing a technology stability committee modeled on the Financial Stability Board "makes sense."
- **The Framing:** Carney cast it as an opportunity that would ultimately "create greater value" and deliver better value to people. He noted that the industry itself is seeking "a certain degree of coordination," and said Canada has already discussed AI safety with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
- **What It Would Be:** The idea is closer to a cooperation and coordination body covering AI, computing infrastructure, data, supply chains, and national security than an independent AI-safety regulator. Like the FSB, it would discuss common standards and risk-response approaches rather than directly enforce national policies.
- **What Is Unsettled:** No official name, member countries, decision-making structure, funding, legal authority, or establishment timeline has been decided. It is unclear whether it would be a formal international organization or an advisory body, and whether the US and China would participate — a question that matters given that both are central to the capabilities the body would oversee.
- **Canada's Domestic Context:** The proposal extends Canada's national AI strategy, "AI for All," announced in June, which commits over CA$2.3 billion over five years and targets up to 250,000 AI-related jobs by 2031, raising business AI adoption from about 12% to 60% by 2034 and aiming for CA$200 billion in economic growth. Canada is also pursuing a "Sovereign Technology Alliance" with Germany, Australia, the EU, the UK, and India, though it is undecided whether that would become the new international AI safety body.
- **Why It Lands Now:** The proposal arrives in a week of unusually dense governance activity — Anthropic and OpenAI asking for mandatory federal testing, California enacting an independent AI auditor registry, Microsoft publishing a model code of conduct, and the White House rejecting slowdown calls outright. The FSB analogy is instructive precisely because that body has no enforcement power either; it works by convening regulators and publishing risk assessments that members then act on domestically.

zh.title: 卡尼提议设立对标金融稳定理事会的全球「技术稳定委员会」
zh.excerpt: 加拿大总理称行业本身正在寻求协调，渥太华已与 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌讨论过 AI 安全。成员国、法定权限与时间表均未确定。
zh.content:
**借用金融稳定理事会的思路**

- **提议：** 加拿大总理马克·卡尼在接受彭博采访时提议设立一个全球性「技术稳定」机构，以监管人工智能并保障其安全发展。他表示需要更多协调，设立一个对标金融稳定委员会（FSB）的技术稳定委员会「是合理的」。
- **定位：** 卡尼将其描述为一个机遇，最终将「创造更大的价值」并向人们提供更好的价值交付。他指出，行业本身正在寻求「一定程度的协调」，并表示加拿大已与 OpenAI、Anthropic 和谷歌讨论过 AI 安全。
- **它更像什么：** 这一构想更接近覆盖 AI、算力基础设施、数据、供应链与国家安全的合作协调机构，而非独立的 AI 安全监管机构。与 FSB 类似，它讨论共同标准与风险应对方式，而不直接执行各国政策。
- **尚未确定的部分：** 官方名称、成员国、决策结构、资金来源、法定权限与成立时间表均未确定。它将成为正式国际组织还是咨询机构尚不明确，美国与中国是否参与同样未知——鉴于两国在該机构将要监管的能力中都处于核心位置，这个问题至关重要。
- **加拿大的国内背景：** 该提议是对加拿大 6 月宣布的国家 AI 战略「AI for All」的延伸，后者承诺五年投入超 23 亿加元，目标到 2031 年创造多达 25 万个 AI 相关岗位，到 2034 年将企业 AI 采用率从约 12% 提升至 60%，并实现 2000 亿加元的经济增长。加拿大还在推动与德国、澳大利亚、欧盟、英国和印度的「主权技术联盟」，但尚未决定该联盟是否会成为新的国际 AI 安全机构。
- **为何此刻提出：** 该提议出现在治理活动异常密集的一周——Anthropic 与 OpenAI 请求联邦强制测试，加州立法建立独立 AI 审计师注册库，微软发布模型行为准则，而白宫则明确拒绝了减速呼吁。FSB 这个类比之所以有启发，恰恰在于该机构同样没有执法权；它的运作方式是召集监管者并发布风险评估，再由成员在国内落实。

en.title: Dreamforce Opens With Salesforce Betting Its Pricing Model on Agents
en.excerpt: Agentforce Winter '27 adds autonomous voice and 100+ prebuilt skills, and packages shift from per-seat to credit consumption. The Claudeforce partnership with Anthropic still has no combined price.
en.content:
**Twenty-Five Years of Per-Seat Pricing Meets Agents**

- **The Event:** Salesforce's Dreamforce conference runs September 15–17, 2026, in San Francisco, gathering more than 43,000 attendees and featuring both Anthropic and OpenAI. A conversation between Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on the future of frontier AI is among the headline sessions.
- **The Product:** Agentforce Winter '27, general availability expected October 12, adds autonomous voice programming, marketing campaign agents, over 100 prebuilt skills, and cross-platform agent coordination, plus compatibility with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google.
- **The Pricing Shift:** Salesforce is moving Agentforce to three packages — Core from $195 per user per month, Advanced at $395, and Max at $550 — shifting from per-user to task and consumption-based pricing through included credits. Benioff has framed the goal as "charging $2 for every $20 or $40 in revenue the software helps generate."
- **Claudeforce:** The expanded partnership with Anthropic, announced August 26, lets Claude operate as a reasoning model inside Agentforce, while Claude users get access to Salesforce data through a "Salesforce in Claude" add-on offering 37 prebuilt skills for sales teams — meeting prep, deal health review, pipeline review, email drafting, and record updates. It is in pilot now, with an open beta expected in September and more skills rolling out from late 2026.
- **The Unresolved Part:** There is no published rate card for Salesforce in Claude, and no combined price. Customers contract separately with Salesforce for platform access and with Anthropic for Claude inference at API rates. Salesforce President Patrick Stokes conceded, "you can't buy this on one piece of paper at the moment." Salesforce charges headless API consumption tied to license edition — Enterprise allows 1,000 calls per license per day, Unlimited 5,000 — while Anthropic bills token usage separately.
- **Why It Matters Beyond Salesforce:** The shift from seats to consumption and outcomes is the same question every enterprise software vendor now faces as agents do work that humans used to do. Per-seat pricing assumes a human is the unit of value; agent pricing has to price the work itself, and no one has settled how — which is why analysts warn the FY27 sales-tech budget may be "short by an amount nobody has yet quantified."

zh.title: Dreamforce 开幕：Salesforce 押注智能体重构定价模式
zh.excerpt: Agentforce Winter '27 新增自主语音与 100 多项预置技能，套餐从按席位转向按点数消费。与 Anthropic 的 Claudeforce 合作至今仍无合并报价。
zh.content:
**25 年的按席位定价，撞上智能体**

- **活动：** Salesforce 的 Dreamforce 大会于 2026 年 9 月 15 日至 17 日在旧金山举行，逾 4.3 万名参会者到场，Anthropic 与 OpenAI 均出席。Salesforce CEO 马克·贝尼奥夫与 OpenAI CEO 山姆·奥特曼关于前沿 AI 未来的对话是重点环节之一。
- **产品：** Agentforce Winter '27 预计于 10 月 12 日正式可用，新增自主语音编排、营销活动智能体、100 多项预置技能与跨平台智能体协同，并兼容 AWS、微软 Azure 与谷歌。
- **定价转向：** Salesforce 将 Agentforce 调整为三档套餐——Core 每用户每月 195 美元起、Advanced 395 美元、Max 550 美元——通过内含点数从按用户计费转向按任务与消费计费。贝尼奥夫将目标概括为「软件每帮客户产生 20 或 40 美元收入，我们收 2 美元」。
- **Claudeforce：** 与 Anthropic 扩大后的合作于 8 月 26 日宣布，让 Claude 在 Agentforce 内充当推理模型；同时 Claude 用户可通过「Salesforce in Claude」插件访问 Salesforce 数据，获得面向销售团队的 37 项预置技能——会议准备、商机健康度评估、管道回顾、邮件撰写与记录更新。目前已进入试点，9 月预计开放公开测试，更多技能自 2026 年底起陆续推出。
- **尚未解决的部分：** Salesforce in Claude 没有公布价目表，也没有合并报价。客户需分别与 Salesforce 签约平台访问、与 Anthropic 按 API 费率结算 Claude 推理费用。Salesforce 总裁 Patrick Stokes 承认：「目前你没法在一张纸上把它买下来。」Salesforce 按许可证版本收取 headless API 调用费用——Enterprise 版每许可证每日 1000 次调用，Unlimited 版 5000 次——而 Anthropic 另行按 token 用量计费。
- **超越 Salesforce 的意义：** 从按席位转向按消费与结果计费，是如今每家企业管理软件厂商都要面对的问题——智能体正在承担过去由人完成的工作。按席位定价的前提是「以人为价值单位」；智能体定价则必须为工作本身定价，而没有人确定该怎么做——这正是分析师警告 2027 财年销售技术预算可能「短缺的数额还没人能算出来」的原因。

en.title: Chinese Researchers Publish a Five-Level Ladder for Recursive Self-Improvement
en.excerpt: A 75-page roadmap distinguishes genuine RSI — improving how you improve — from ordinary self-modification, and finds no frontier system credibly claiming the top level. Most sit at the bottom two.
en.content:
**Defining the Thing Everyone Is Arguing About**

- **The Paper:** "The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement" (arXiv:2609.11873) is a roughly 75-page paper published around September 10–11, 2026. It is led by Yi Duan and Ying Liu with a large co-author list and Xuanhe Zhou as corresponding author, spanning Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tsinghua University, ByteDance, Shanghai AI Lab, ModelBest, Theseus Labs, Xiaohongshu, and XianYuan Technology.
- **The Definition:** The paper separates genuine Recursive Self-Improvement from looser uses of the term. Genuine RSI is a closed loop in which a system identifies its own limitations, proposes and validates modifications, retains accepted changes, and — the dividing line — influences how future improvements are generated, evaluated, selected, and consolidated. That last step means "improving how you improve." Once a system reaches it, the title argues, subsequent generations are shaped by the prior AI's self-improvement mechanism rather than by humans.
- **The Ladder:** B0 is in-task autonomy with no self-improvement. L1 is executing improvement steps a human defined. L2 is choosing among human-defined improvement options. L3 is generating its own learning experiences through adaptive task generation and self-play. L4 is adapting continuously in live deployment, distilling experience into memory or codebase. L5 is persistently modifying the mechanism that governs future improvements — the improver, search algorithm, or evaluator itself. L5 splits further into structural recursion, where the AI modifies mechanisms used in later rounds, and effective recursion, where those modifications demonstrably produce stronger successors under comparable budgets and independent evaluation.
- **What the Survey Found:** Across the surveyed body of work, the distribution concentrates at the lower levels: L1 about 43.8%, L2 about 31.6%, L3 about 13.0%, L4 about 5.7%, and L5 about 5.9%. No current frontier system credibly claims L5; most sit at B0 or L1. The authors stress that L1–L5 is their proposed framework, not an industry-recognized standard.
- **The Metric:** The paper introduces the Headroom-Closed Index, aggregating roughly 393 model-benchmark observations across ten domains to compare capability progress against observable ceilings. Progress is uneven: software engineering, tool use, and search and terminal workflows retain the most headroom, which the authors argue is where RSI matters most. Software engineering is identified as the most fertile application domain, with bounded L5 characteristics already emerging.
- **The Risks:** Three recurring problems undermine credible RSI claims: safe inheritance, since persisted changes can carry errors or degrade prior capabilities; autonomy attribution, distinguishing AI-controlled decisions from fixed search procedures; and reliable verification, guarding against reward hacking and evaluator exploitation.
- **Why It Matters:** Amodei's pacing essay treats recursive self-improvement as the central risk and says it should be pursued cautiously if at all; Z.AI raised $5 billion partly to build it. This paper is the most systematic attempt to say what the term actually means, which makes it the natural yardstick for both claims — and its answer is that the capability driving the entire debate is, so far, mostly aspirational.

zh.title: 中国研究者发布递归自我改进五级阶梯：多数系统仍处最低两级
zh.excerpt: 这份 75 页路线图区分了「真正的 RSI」——改进你如何改进——与普通的自我修改，并发现没有任何前沿系统可信地达到最高层级。
zh.content:
**为这场争论中的核心概念下定义**

- **论文：** 《The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement》（arXiv:2609.11873）是一篇约 75 页的论文，于 2026 年 9 月 10 日至 11 日前后发表。论文由 Yi Duan、Ying Liu 领衔，作者名单很长，通讯作者为 Xuanhe Zhou，参与机构涵盖上海交通大学、清华大学、字节跳动、上海人工智能实验室、面壁智能、Theseus Labs、小红书与弦元科技。
- **定义：** 论文将「真正的递归自我改进」与这一术语的宽泛用法区分开来。真正的 RSI 是一个闭环：系统识别自身局限、提出并验证修改、保留被接受的改动，并且——这是分界线——影响未来改进方案如何被生成、评估、选择与固化。最后这一步意味着「改进你如何改进」。论文标题主张，一旦系统达到这一步，后续世代便由前代 AI 的自我改进机制塑造，而非由人类塑造。
- **阶梯：** B0 是任务内自主，不涉及自我改进。L1 是执行人类定义的改进步骤。L2 是在人类定义的改进选项中做选择。L3 是通过自适应任务生成与自我博弈产生自己的学习经验。L4 是在实际部署中持续适应，把经验提炼进记忆或代码库。L5 是持续修改支配未来改进的机制本身——改进器、搜索算法或评估器。L5 又分为「结构性递归」（AI 修改后续轮次所用的机制）与「有效性递归」（这些修改在可比预算与独立评估下确实产出更强的后继者）。
- **调研发现：** 在受调查的文献中，分布集中在较低层级：L1 约 43.8%，L2 约 31.6%，L3 约 13.0%，L4 约 5.7%，L5 约 5.9%。目前没有任何前沿系统可信地声称达到 L5，多数处于 B0 或 L1。作者强调，L1–L5 是他们提出的框架，并非业界公认标准。
- **指标：** 论文提出「余量收敛指数」（Headroom-Closed Index），汇总横跨十个领域、约 393 项模型—基准观测，用以比较能力进展与可观测上限之间的距离。进展并不均衡：软件工程、工具使用与搜索/终端工作流保留的余量最多，作者认为这正是 RSI 最关键的领域。软件工程被认定为最丰沃的应用领域，已出现有界的 L5 特征。
- **风险：** 三个反复出现的问题削弱着可信的 RSI 主张：「安全继承」——被固化的改动可能携带错误或削弱既有能力；「自主性归因」——难以区分由 AI 控制的决策与固定的搜索流程；「可靠验证」——需防范奖励作弊与对评估器的利用。
- **为何重要：** Amodei 的定速文章把递归自我改进视为核心风险，主张即便要做也应极其谨慎；智谱则融资 50 亿美元部分用于建设它。这篇论文是对该术语含义最系统的界定尝试，因此自然成为衡量双方主张的标尺——而它给出的答案是：驱动整场争论的这项能力，目前大多仍停留在愿景阶段。

en.title: Unitree Releases the G1+ Humanoid at 95,000 Yuan With Six Upgrades
en.excerpt: The upgrade adds a two-degree-of-freedom neck, stronger and cooler-running motors, binocular vision with 3D LiDAR, and a six-microphone array — at the same cost-performance positioning as the G1.
en.content:
**Cheap Humanoids Keep Getting Better**

- **The Release:** Unitree released the G1+ humanoid robot on September 14, 2026, an upgraded version of its G1. The company describes six upgrades across three areas — motion performance, perception and interaction, and intelligent experience — while keeping the G1's cost-performance positioning. The standard version is priced at 95,000 yuan including tax; pricing for the G1+ EDU version aimed at research and deep development has not been announced.
- **Motion:** A new two-degree-of-freedom neck structure with a pitch range of about -25° to 36° and yaw up to ±110°. Shoulder and waist motors gain 110% peak torque with 72% less heat at the same torque; arm motors gain 43% peak torque with 30% less heat; thigh motors run 28% cooler at the same torque. The robot uses low-inertia high-speed inner-rotor permanent magnet synchronous motors, local air cooling, industrial-grade crossed roller bearings, and dual encoders.
- **Perception:** A binocular plus wide-angle monocular vision system — the binocular camera with a 60mm baseline and 2MP resolution (110° horizontal, 80° vertical, 125° diagonal field of view), the wide-angle monocular at 1920×1080 at 30fps (117° horizontal, 67° vertical) — plus 3D LiDAR and an abdominal wide-angle camera.
- **Interaction:** Five high-sensitivity touch points on the head; a six-microphone array (four front, two back) with direction-of-arrival sound localization, noise reduction, and echo cancellation; support for an external wireless microphone rated for 50m transmission and 80dB signal-to-noise; and dual 10W speakers at the waist.
- **Power and Specs:** A new rear external power port at DC 54.6V, 5.7A; a 13-series lithium 9000mAh detachable smart battery with a 54V/5A charger and about two hours of rated battery life. OTA upgrades, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, an eight-core high-performance CPU, and a handheld remote. The robot weighs about 35kg, stands at roughly 1340×450×200mm and folds to about 690×450×300mm, with 25 joint-motor degrees of freedom (two head, six per leg, one waist, five per arm), a maximum arm load of about 3kg, and a 0.45m arm span.
- **The EDU Variant:** Expands to 25+45 degrees of freedom, an optional 3-DOF waist, an optional 7-DOF dexterous hand plus 2 wrist DOF, and arm load increased to about 4kg. It supports multi-brand high-compute modules such as Orin and secondary development, with warranty extended from eight months on the standard version to 18 months.
- **The Context:** The release lands in a week when cheap humanoids were a theme on both sides of the Pacific — Y Combinator's Summer 2026 Demo Day featured Nori, a household-chore humanoid priced around $1,600. The gap between those price points and the enterprise robotics market is the story: capability is improving fast at the low end while the high end absorbs most of the capital.

zh.title: 宇树发布人形机器人 G1+：六项升级，标准版售价 9.5 万元
zh.excerpt: 此次升级新增两个自由度颈部、扭矩更强散热更好的电机、双目视觉加 3D 激光雷达与六麦克风阵列，延续 G1 的高性价比定位。
zh.content:
**便宜的人形机器人还在变强**

- **发布：** 宇树科技于 2026 年 9 月 14 日发布人形机器人 G1+，为 G1 的升级版本。公司称其在运动性能、感知交互与智能体验三方面带来六项升级，同时延续 G1 的高性价比定位。标准版含税售价 9.5 万元；面向科研与深度开发的 G1+ EDU 版价格尚未公布。
- **运动：** 新增两自由度颈部结构，俯仰范围约 -25° 至 36°，偏航可达 ±110°。肩部与腰部电机峰值扭矩提升 110%，同等扭矩下发热降低 72%；手臂电机峰值扭矩提升 43%，发热降低 30%；大腿电机同等扭矩下发热降低 28%。机器人采用低惯量高速内转子永磁同步电机、局部风冷、工业级交叉滚子轴承与双编码器。
- **感知：** 双目加广角单目视觉方案——双目相机基线 60mm、200 万像素（水平 110°、垂直 80°、对角 125° 视场角），广角单目为 1920×1080@30fps（水平 117°、垂直 67°）——另配 3D 激光雷达与腹部广角相机。
- **交互：** 头部 5 个高灵敏度触摸点；6 麦克风阵列（前 4 后 2），具备声源定位（DOA）、降噪与回声消除；支持外接无线麦克风（额定传输 50 米、信噪比 80dB）；腰部配备双 10W 扬声器。
- **供电与规格：** 新增后部外接供电接口（DC 54.6V，5.7A）；13 串锂 9000mAh 可拆卸智能电池，配 54V/5A 充电器，额定续航约 2 小时。支持 OTA 升级、Wi-Fi 6、蓝牙 5.2、八核高性能 CPU 与手持遥控器。机器人重约 35kg，站立尺寸约 1340×450×200mm，折叠后约 690×450×300mm，共 25 个关节电机自由度（头部 2、单腿 6、腰部 1、单臂 5），手臂最大负载约 3kg，臂展约 0.45m。
- **EDU 版本：** 自由度扩展至 25+45，可选 3 自由度腰部、可选 7 自由度灵巧手加 2 个腕部自由度，手臂最大负载提升至约 4kg。支持 Orin 等多品牌高算力模块与二次开发，质保由标准版的 8 个月延长至 18 个月。
- **背景：** 此次发布正值廉价人形机器人成为太平洋两岸的共同主题——Y Combinator 2026 夏季 Demo Day 上出现了定价约 1600 美元的家务人形机器人 Nori。这些价格点与企业级机器人市场之间的落差正是故事所在：低端能力快速提升，而资本仍主要集中在高端。

en.title: Cowboy Space Raises $275 Million to Put AI Data Centers in Orbit
en.excerpt: The Robinhood co-founder's startup treats a rocket's upper stage as a 1-megawatt data center once in orbit. Google researchers estimate launch costs must fall to about $200/kg from roughly $3,400 today.
en.content:
**Sidestepping Earth's Bottlenecks, 500 Kilometers Up**

- **The Raise:** Cowboy Space Corporation raised $275 million in a Series B at a $2 billion post-money valuation, led by existing investor Index Ventures with participation from new investors IVP, Blossom Capital, and SAIC, alongside existing backers Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos, and founder Baiju Bhatt. Total funding reaches roughly $365 million.
- **The Company:** Founded in 2024 by Baiju Bhatt, co-founder of Robinhood, the California startup originally operated as Aetherflux, focused on harvesting solar energy in space and beaming it to Earth, before rebranding and pivoting toward orbital data centers.
- **What It's Building:** Vertically integrated infrastructure to run AI compute in orbit — a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites powered by solar energy, plus its own purpose-built launch vehicle. The key design idea is treating the rocket's upper stage and the data center payload as a single system: once in orbit, each upper stage becomes a 1-megawatt data center, reducing redundant mass.
- **The Roadmap:** Cowboy plans to launch its first satellite later this year, in partnership with satellite manufacturer Apex, to demonstrate space-to-Earth power beaming, then deploy its first "Galactic Brain" node, and aims for a first proprietary rocket carrying a 1 MW data center by the end of 2028. Satellites are expected to mass 20,000–25,000 kg and generate 1 MW for just under 800 GPUs. The company is also collaborating with Nvidia to deploy Space-1 Vera Rubin Modules in low Earth orbit.
- **Why Orbit:** The thesis is to sidestep Earth's AI bottlenecks — soaring electricity demand, land scarcity, water for cooling, and grid and utility constraints — by using near-continuous solar power in space. Bhatt said insufficient launch capacity from third parties drove the decision to build its own rockets.
- **The Obstacles:** Sources flag unresolved engineering and economic hurdles: dissipating heat from power-hungry GPUs in a vacuum, potentially using the rocket fairing as a giant radiator; high-bandwidth low-latency laser communication between thousands of satellites; and launch cost. Google researchers estimate launch costs must fall to about $200 per kilogram, against roughly $3,400/kg on a Falcon 9 today — a 17-fold gap that no current vehicle closes. Cowboy has hired veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, NASA, Kuiper, Astranis, and Nvidia, including former SpaceX launch director Tyler Grinnell, and is opening a Seattle hub seeking 40 to 60 employees initially.

zh.title: Cowboy Space 融资 2.75 亿美元，要把 AI 数据中心送入轨道
zh.excerpt: 这家由 Robinhood 联合创始人创办的公司，把火箭上面级设计为入轨后的 1 兆瓦数据中心。谷歌研究者估算，发射成本需从现在约每公斤 3400 美元降至约 200 美元。
zh.content:
**在 500 公里高空绕开地球的瓶颈**

- **融资：** Cowboy Space Corporation 完成 2.75 亿美元 B 轮融资，投后估值 20 亿美元，由现有投资方 Index Ventures 领投，新投资方 IVP、Blossom Capital 与 SAIC 参投，现有股东 Breakthrough Energy Ventures、Construct Capital、Andreessen Horowitz、NEA、Interlagos 以及创始人 Baiju Bhatt 跟投。累计融资约 3.65 亿美元。
- **公司：** 这家加州初创公司由 Robinhood 联合创始人 Baiju Bhatt 于 2024 年创办，最初名为 Aetherflux，专注于在太空收集太阳能并传回地球，后更名并转向轨道数据中心。
- **在建之物：** 一套垂直整合的轨道 AI 算力基础设施——由太阳能供电的低轨卫星星座，以及自研运载火箭。其核心设计思路是把火箭上面级与数据中心载荷视为一个整体系统：入轨后，每个上面级即成为一个 1 兆瓦数据中心，从而减少冗余质量。
- **路线图：** Cowboy 计划今年晚些时候与卫星制造商 Apex 合作发射首颗卫星，演示太空向地球的电力传输，随后部署首个「Galactic Brain」节点，目标是到 2028 年底让首枚自研火箭搭载 1 兆瓦数据中心入轨。卫星质量预计为 2 万至 2.5 万公斤，以 1 兆瓦功率驱动近 800 块 GPU。公司还与英伟达合作，在低轨部署 Space-1 Vera Rubin 模块。
- **为何选择轨道：** 其论点是利用太空中近乎连续的太阳能，绕开地球上的 AI 瓶颈——电力需求激增、土地稀缺、冷却用水以及电网与公用事业的约束。Bhatt 表示，第三方发射能力不足是决定自研火箭的原因。
- **障碍：** 消息源指出了尚未解决的工程与经济难题：在真空中为高功耗 GPU 散热，可能的方案是把火箭整流罩当作巨型散热器；数千颗卫星之间需要高带宽低延迟的激光通信；以及发射成本。谷歌研究者估算，发射成本需降至约每公斤 200 美元，而目前猎鹰 9 号约为每公斤 3400 美元——17 倍的差距，现有运载器无一能弥合。Cowboy 已招募来自 SpaceX、Blue Origin、NASA、Kuiper、Astranis 与英伟达的资深人员，包括前 SpaceX 发射主管 Tyler Grinnell，并正在西雅图设立中心，初期招聘 40 至 60 人。

en.title: Suno Launches v6, Its First Model Family Trained on Licensed Music
en.excerpt: The three-model v6 family replaces the entire previous lineup and was built with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe. Universal and Sony are still suing.
en.content:
**Licensing Its Way Out of Litigation**

- **The Launch:** Suno launched its v6 family of AI music models on September 9, 2026 — the first generation developed with music industry partners, including Warner Music Group, BMG, and distributor Believe. It marks the first time Suno has built models using licensed music from industry partners, following years of copyright litigation over its earlier models.
- **The Family:** Three models. v6 is the flagship for Pro and Premier subscribers, described as reliable and precise and capable of polished music across genres. v6-wild is an experimental model for Pro and Premier, designed for exploration and producing less predictable, more varied results — tuned less toward average user preferences to serve artists wanting a creative partner rather than the "best single output." v6-mini is a faster, more efficient version available to all users including free accounts. The family replaces Suno's entire previous lineup of v4.5, v5, and v5.5.
- **Training Data:** Suno says v6 was "trained from the ground up" on a new dataset distinct from prior models, including licensed music from partners — Warner, BMG, and music from participating Believe and TuneCore artists — plus user data and internal R&D. The company has not disclosed specific dataset composition or payment amounts.
- **New Capabilities:** Natural-language section editing, letting users change one part of a song in plain language ("change the chorus so it's sung by a gospel choir") without regenerating the rest; single-lyric editing to swap a word or line without rebuilding the track; mashups combining elements from multiple sources in one request; sampling and isolation to pull out an instrument and build a new beat in one workflow; multimodal creation from text, audio, images, or video; and vibe-based prompting from a mood, genre, or mix of inspirations. Suno also demonstrated a "Create Custom Model" beta for building a model from your own uploads, though details were not in the launch blog post.
- **The Business Model:** From launch day, Suno began sharing a portion of revenue with label partners, with rightsholders receiving payment and deciding how to distribute it to artists and songwriters. An opt-in program letting individual artists participate in AI remix experiences and get paid is in development but not live with v6.
- **The Legal Picture:** Warner Music Group sued Suno, then settled and became a development partner. Suno struck a deal with BMG in August 2026 and with Believe and TuneCore just before launch. Universal Music Group and Sony Music are still suing, along with musicians including Jason Isbell, plus Socan and Round Hill Music. A German court in Munich ruled against Suno in a GEMA case.
- **The Framing:** Suno's Chief Product Officer Jack Brody called v6 the company's "most powerful music creation tools to date" and "the foundation for The Everything Model."

zh.title: Suno 发布 v6：首个基于授权音乐训练的模型家族
zh.excerpt: v6 三款模型取代此前全部型号，由华纳音乐、BMG 与 Believe 参与开发。环球与索尼的诉讼仍在进行中。
zh.content:
**用授权协议走出诉讼**

- **发布：** Suno 于 2026 年 9 月 9 日推出 v6 系列 AI 音乐模型——这是首个与音乐产业伙伴共同开发的世代，合作方包括华纳音乐集团、BMG 与发行商 Believe。这标志着 Suno 首次使用产业伙伴的授权音乐构建模型，此前其早期模型已历经多年版权诉讼。
- **三款模型：** v6 是面向 Pro 与 Premier 订阅用户的旗舰，被描述为可靠、精确，能在各类型与风格上产出精良作品。v6-wild 是面向 Pro 与 Premier 的实验性模型，为探索而生，产出更不可预测、更多样化的结果——它较少向普通用户偏好调优，服务于那些想要创作伙伴而非「单一最佳输出」的艺术家。v6-mini 是更快、更高效的版本，面向包括免费账户在内的所有用户开放。该系列取代了 Suno 此前 v4.5、v5 与 v5.5 的全部型号。
- **训练数据：** Suno 称 v6 是「从零开始」在一个有别于以往模型的新数据集上训练的，包含来自合作伙伴的授权音乐——华纳、BMG 以及参与计划的 Believe 与 TuneCore 艺术家的作品——外加用户数据与内部研发成果。公司未披露具体的数据集构成或付款金额。
- **新能力：** 自然语言分段编辑，让用户用大白话改动歌曲的某一部分（例如「把副歌改成福音合唱团演唱」）而无需重新生成其余部分；单句歌词编辑，可替换一个词或一行而不重建整首曲目；混搭（mashup），在一次请求中组合多个来源的元素；采样与分离，把某个乐器单独提取出来并在同一流程中构建新节拍；多模态创作，支持从文本、音频、图像或视频生成音乐；基于氛围的提示，从某种情绪、类型或灵感组合出发创作。Suno 还演示了「创建自定义模型」测试版，可用自己上传的内容构建模型，但细节未出现在发布博文中。
- **商业模式：** 自发布之日起，Suno 开始与厂牌伙伴分享部分收入，版权方获得付款并自行决定如何向艺人与词曲作者分发。一项允许独立艺术家参与 AI 混音体验并获得报酬的加入制计划正在开发中，尚未随 v6 上线。
- **法律图景：** 华纳音乐集团曾起诉 Suno，后达成和解并成为开发伙伴。Suno 于 2026 年 8 月与 BMG 达成协议，并在发布前夕与 Believe 和 TuneCore 签约。环球音乐集团与索尼音乐仍在起诉，参与方还包括 Jason Isbell 等音乐人，以及 Socan 与 Round Hill Music。德国慕尼黑一家法院在 GEMA 案中作出了不利于 Suno 的裁决。
- **官方定位：** Suno 首席产品官 Jack Brody 称 v6 是公司「迄今最强大的音乐创作工具」，也是「The Everything Model 的基础」。

en.title: Y Combinator's Summer Batch Pivots Hard to Deep Tech — and None of the Hottest Nine Are AI Apps
en.excerpt: Industrial deep tech doubled to 23.7% of the batch. The buzziest startups include ocean-floor data centers, chips with weights baked into silicon, a $1,600 humanoid and brain-cell computing.
en.content:
**Science Fiction, Restrained Valuations**

- **The Batch:** Y Combinator's Summer 2026 Demo Day was held September 10, 2026, with roughly 235 companies — about 20% more than the prior batch. The share of industrial deep tech reportedly doubled from 12.8% to 23.7%. Notably, none of the nine buzziest startups selected by investors were AI application companies. According to TechCrunch, which surveyed early-stage VCs, the cohort's ideas felt "like science fiction," though valuations were more restrained than recent batches.
- **Power and Energy:** Automarine (also spelled Atomarine), founded by MIT engineers, plans to place data centers on floating ocean barges using seawater for near-free cooling, targeting a gas-powered pilot by 2028 and a transition to floating nuclear-powered vessels by 2032. It claims over $4 billion in customer interest via letters of intent and was cited as one of the highest-valued startups of the batch.
- **Chips and Networking:** Dipole Labs builds optical networking hardware for AI data centers, with an optical switch that keeps data as light rather than converting light to electricity and back, cutting energy consumption and heat. Lamb Labs, founded by an Imperial College AI PhD and an Oxford theoretical physicist, develops custom inference chips — "Model Processing Units" — that hardcode AI model weights directly into silicon to eliminate the memory bandwidth bottleneck. Parasma explores training human brain cells for computing as a more energy-efficient alternative to modern AI hardware.
- **Robotics:** Praxis AI collects real-world video and data of people performing work tasks to train robots, reportedly across more than 150 environments. Nori is a humanoid for household chores — cleaning, folding clothes — priced at about $1,600, far below the roughly $20,000 Neo benchmark; launched six weeks earlier, it reported nearly $500,000 in sales. Cosmic Robotics builds autonomous robots for heavy lifting, already used to install solar panels in the US, with $25 million in contracts through 2027. Waddle Labs offers an API layer where LLM-based agents generate and verify robot control code, letting robots take natural-language commands.
- **Defense:** Isengard Industries, founded partly by a former Australian Army officer, aims to mass-produce jet-powered strike and counter-drone systems in allied countries at a fraction of traditional contractor costs. It reported $10 million in revenue, and a co-founder previously scaled a Ukraine-focused drone startup to $60 million.
- **The Caveat:** The shift to hard tech brings a different risk profile than software — capital-intensive spending, long development timelines, and regulatory hurdles in energy, nuclear, and defense. Analysts caution that many company-reported figures, including contracts, revenue, and letters of intent, lack independent verification, and that the key test will be moving from prototypes to cost-effective manufacturing.

zh.title: Y Combinator 夏季批次大举转向深科技，最热门九家无一为 AI 应用
zh.excerpt: 工业深科技占比从 12.8% 翻倍至 23.7%。最受关注的初创公司包括海底数据中心、把权重烧进硅片的芯片、1600 美元人形机器人与脑细胞计算。
zh.content:
**科幻般的构想，克制的估值**

- **批次：** Y Combinator 2026 夏季 Demo Day 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日举行，约 235 家公司，较上一批多出约 20%。据报道，工业深科技的占比从 12.8% 翻倍至 23.7%。值得注意的是，投资人评选出的九家最热门初创公司中，没有一家是 AI 应用公司。据 TechCrunch 对早期投资人的调研，这一批的想法「像科幻小说」，但估值比近期几批更为克制。
- **能源与电力：** 由麻省理工工程师创办的 Automarine（亦写作 Atomarine）计划把数据中心置于海上驳船，利用海水实现近乎免费的冷却，目标是 2028 年完成燃气动力试点，2032 年转向浮动核动力船舶。该公司声称通过意向书获得逾 40 亿美元的客户兴趣，被认为是本批估值最高的初创公司之一。
- **芯片与网络：** Dipole Labs 为 AI 数据中心构建光网络硬件，其光交换机让数据始终以光的形式传输，跳过「光—电—光」转换，从而降低能耗与发热。由帝国理工学院 AI 博士与牛津理论物理学家创办的 Lamb Labs 研发定制推理芯片——「模型处理单元」（MPU）——把 AI 模型权重直接硬编码进硅片，以消除内存带宽瓶颈。Parasma 则探索训练人类脑细胞进行计算，作为比现代 AI 硬件更节能的替代方案。
- **机器人：** Praxis AI 采集人们执行工作任务的真实视频与数据来训练机器人，据报道覆盖 150 多个环境。Nori 是面向家务（清洁、叠衣）的人形机器人，定价约 1600 美元，远低于约 2 万美元的 Neo 基准；发布六周即报告近 50 万美元销售额。Cosmic Robotics 打造用于重物搬运的自主机器人，已在美国用于安装太阳能板，截至 2027 年手握 2500 万美元合同。Waddle Labs 提供 API 层，让基于 LLM 的智能体生成并验证机器人控制代码，使机器人能接受自然语言指令。
- **国防：** Isengard Industries 部分由前澳大利亚陆军军官创办，目标是在盟国以远低于传统承包商成本的方式量产喷气动力打击与反无人机系统。该公司报告 1000 万美元收入，一位联合创始人此前曾把一家专注乌克兰的无人机初创公司做到 6000 万美元规模。
- **保留意见：** 转向硬科技带来与软件不同的风险轮廓——资本密集的支出、漫长的开发周期，以及能源、核能与国防领域的监管障碍。分析师提醒，许多公司自报的数据——包括合同、收入与意向书——缺乏独立核验，而关键考验将是从原型走向具备成本效益的量产。

en.title: Shanghai AI Lab Open-Sources Intern-S2, a 35B Scientific Model That Rivals Trillion-Parameter Systems
en.excerpt: The multimodal model surpasses closed flagships on crystal structure generation and molecular benchmarks, and plugs into the Lab's Duanyan scientific discovery platform.
en.content:
**Small Model, Scientific Benchmarks**

- **The Release:** Shanghai AI Laboratory released the 书生 (Intern) S2 multimodal large model on September 13, 2026, at the AI for Science forum of the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum. It is an open-source foundational model designed to serve long-cycle scientific research tasks, emphasizing improved long-horizon research capabilities and agent abilities, and using a new architecture to explore continuous expansion of specialized scientific knowledge.
- **The Performance Claim:** An earlier preview, Intern-S2-Preview, was open-sourced on May 15, 2026, with only 35 billion parameters yet reportedly matching trillion-parameter models in several core areas. Highlights include being the first open-source general model to achieve material crystal structure generation through a real-number prediction module, with a crystal structure pass rate above 40% against about 10% for closed models such as GPT-5.5. It scored 57.26 on MolecularIQ, beating Gemini-3.1-Pro's 41.33, and surpassed mainstream closed models including Claude-Haiku-4.5 and GPT5.4-Nano on scientific discovery tasks, while leading its size class in scientific coding (SciCode) and agent benchmarks (PinchBench).
- **General Capability:** The full S2 release reaches the first tier of open-source models on general abilities spanning knowledge, code, and agents, and performs strongly on scientific tasks in life sciences and materials — including Biology-Instructions and Mol-Instructions — for structure understanding, generation, and design, reportedly surpassing other open and closed flagship models.
- **The Technical Approach:** Built on a general-specialized integration training approach with full-link training and reinforcement learning, including chain-of-thought guidance, extended training steps, and IQPT chain-of-thought folding, plus task scaling. It is deeply coordinated with Huawei's Ascend computing ecosystem, optimized on the Ascend Atlas 900 A3 super node for training, inference, and evaluation.
- **Ecosystem and Availability:** Intern-S2 will be integrated into the upgraded Duanyan scientific discovery platform alongside the Intern physical world model W0. Open-source links include GitHub (InternLM), HuggingFace (internlm/intern-s2 collection), and ModelScope (Shanghai_AI_Laboratory/Intern-S2), with a chat demo at chat.intern-ai.org.cn.
- **Why It Matters:** The claim that a 35B model can rival trillion-parameter systems on scientific tasks is the same efficiency argument Chinese labs have pressed all year — and it lands as Western labs debate slowing down. Whether the benchmarks hold under independent evaluation is the open question; the model is open-weight, so it can be tested.

zh.title: 上海 AI 实验室开源书生-S2：350 亿参数科学模型比肩万亿参数系统
zh.excerpt: 该多模态模型在晶体结构生成与分子基准上超越闭源旗舰，并将接入该实验室的书生·端砚科学发现平台。
zh.content:
**小模型，科学基准**

- **发布：** 上海人工智能实验室于 2026 年 9 月 13 日在 2026 浦江创新论坛「AI for Science」论坛上发布书生多模态大模型 S2。这是一个开源基础模型，专为长周期科研任务设计，强调更强的长程研究能力与智能体能力，并采用创新架构探索专业科学知识的持续扩展。
- **性能主张：** 更早的预览版 Intern-S2-Preview 于 2026 年 5 月 15 日开源，仅 350 亿参数，却据报道在多个核心领域比肩万亿参数模型。亮点包括：首个通过实数预测模块实现材料晶体结构生成的开源通用模型，晶体结构通过率超过 40%，而 GPT-5.5 等闭源模型约为 10%；在 MolecularIQ 上得分 57.26，超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 41.33；在科学发现任务上超越 Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT5.4-Nano 等主流闭源模型，并在科学编程（SciCode）与智能体基准（PinchBench）上领先同尺寸级别。
- **通用能力：** S2 正式版在知识、代码与智能体等通用能力上进入开源模型第一梯队，并在生命科学与材料等领域的科学任务上表现出色——包括 Biology-Instructions 与 Mol-Instructions——涵盖结构理解、生成与设计，据报道超越了其他开源与闭源旗舰模型。
- **技术路径：** 采用「通专融合」训练方法，配合全链路训练与强化学习，包括思维链引导、扩展训练步数与 IQPT 思维链折叠，以及任务 Scaling。模型与华为昇腾计算生态深度协同，在昇腾 Atlas 900 A3 超节点上完成训练、推理与评估优化。
- **生态与获取：** 书生-S2 将接入升级后的书生·端砚科学发现平台，与书生物理世界模型 W0 并列。开源链接包括 GitHub（InternLM）、HuggingFace（internlm/intern-s2 collection）与 ModelScope（Shanghai_AI_Laboratory/Intern-S2），并在 chat.intern-ai.org.cn 提供对话演示。
- **为何重要：** 「350 亿参数模型能在科学任务上比肩万亿参数系统」这一主张，正是中国实验室全年反复强调的效率论点——而它出现的时点，恰是西方实验室辩论是否放慢脚步之际。这些基准能否经得起独立评估是尚未解答的问题；该模型采用开放权重，因此可以被检验。
